quest.title: A Splash of Color on the Plate!
quest.description: You have finished collecting the free-roaming color paints. The colorist Ashas are very pleased with the haul...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Looks like our colorist Ashas are very much satisfied now.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Another challenge completed for our wondrous Ashas!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this Asha here inspired to start another artwork already?

choices.text: Well, you know how inspiration can come and go in the blink of an eye...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: #Ah, look at all the treasure it's left behind... {NICKNAME} and Paimon, the two of you should have it! For all the hard work you've put in!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Maybe the next time we come by, we'll be able to see the colorist Asha's masterpiece.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just imagine what kind of work it would be! Especially when even the regular Ashas are already capable of coming up with such beautiful colors.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can't wait to see what the colorist Ashas will create! Maybe they'll come up with something... beyond what words can describe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe the colors of Phlogiston, the moon, or the depths of the starry sky?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Yeah, that's exactly how it should be! If we come across a creature in some kind of trouble during our adventures, we should do everything we can to help it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm-hmm! Who knows? Maybe one day we'll receive some unexpected rewards!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Ah, but... We shouldn't do it just because of some expected reward. That'd be beside the point.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Even if there's nothing in it for us, helping friends in need and seeing their smiles return as things turn for the better...

choices.text: And it feels very fulfilling as well.
So you have to strike while the iron is still hot.
